PartyCreditProfileInquiry.name: PartyCreditProfileInquiry
PartyCreditProfileInquiry.description: Represents the details of inquiries made by external organizations to access a borrower's credit report. Can influence a lender's opinion of a borrower's risk profile based on the type of credit inquiries received.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

PartyCreditProfileId.description: The party credit profile associated with the inquiry.
